title: Techstack own application v4

image.description: Public DNS registry over HTTPS port 443 only. Go admission rejects IP literals, localhost, single-label hosts, private/reserved/unknown public suffixes; transport rejects non-public DNS answers and HTTP redirects/token endpoints. Create/update dry review resolves tags before approval; offline render requires a digest-pinned desired image. Execution binds the reviewed resolvedImage, imports its verified blobs through the same HTTPS transport, and runs the node-derived immutable config image ID with pull_policy never.

hostname.description: Exactly own-<name>.<installation-domain>; checked contextually by StackKits.

secretRefs.description: Each key K must reference exactly secret://own-<name>/K; created via the own operation private secrets-file, never foreign custody.

mountPath.description: Clean absolute container path; system paths, host mounts and Docker socket are refused.

outboundInternet.description: Kept on when the adopted original had Internet access, unless the plan used --no-outbound. Public IPv4 only, admitted only with the managed host nftables firewall. IPv6 is disabled. Docker never restarts it; after a host reboot the boot-time restore unit re-applies the reviewed rules and starts it (systemd 244 or newer). Rollback keeps this grant: the adoption review granted it to the application, not to one image.

imageDigest.description: Registry manifest digest the original ran.

volumes.description: The one data source copied (never moved or changed) into the named volume.

adoptedFrom.description: Evidence of origin, never runtime authority.

publishedPorts.description: Host ports the original published, each with exactly its original host address (never widened). Published ports put the application on the managed firewall bridge also without outboundInternet: Docker publishes no port of a container on an internal-only bridge, so without outbound Internet the bridge runs an ingress-only ruleset that drops everything the application sends except replies to connections made to it. TCP 80 and 443 belong to the installation router. Update may only clear the list.

hostIP.description: Omitted binds every host address, as the original did.

description: Closed v4 own-application intent: one container StackKits rebuilt from an observed container it did not install (Stack it). The v2 single-container form plus adoptedFrom and publishedPorts. Created only by stackkit app own --from-container; adoptedFrom and publishedPorts are immutable except that update may clear publishedPorts.
